name: Tony Daniel
deck: Tony S. Daniel is an American comic book penciler and writer. He is acclaimed for for his collaboration with writer Grant Morrison on Batman. He took over writing and art duties for the Batman titles, and was the writer and artist for the New 52 reboot of Detective Comics.

name: Walden Wong
deck: Walden Wong is a well-respected comic book artist/inker and has a wide range of experience in the industry. He has worked for practically every publisher out there, including DC, Marvel, Image, Dark Horse, and VIZ media. You can see his name on a variety of titles every year.
